about.title: Meet Houston Realtor Cesar Espinoza
about.text: Cesar Espinoza is a Houston Realtor and Broker Associate with Equity Real Estate, serving buyers and sellers throughout Greater Houston for more than two decades. His experience covers residential sales, buyer representation, relocation, and probate and inherited property, and he is a Certified Probate Real Estate Specialist.
about.imageAlt: Cesar Espinoza with clients at the title company on closing day

facts.heading: Where Cesar works
facts.text: Serving Greater Houston buyers and sellers since 2003, licensed and active across Harris, Fort Bend and Montgomery Counties. Every property is evaluated within its own neighborhood, including HOA, MUD district, flood zone and school district boundaries.

facts.heading: Probate and estate services
items: Inherited property sales and probate listings
Property repair coordination through vetted contractors, cleaners, roofers, painters and stagers
Remote sales for out-of-state executors and heirs, with electronic or mobile-notary signing
Bilingual probate services in English and Spanish

facts.heading: Free guides and home value reports
items: Free, no-obligation comparative market analysis (CMA): send your property address and Cesar prepares it personally
Houston Home Seller's Listing Guide, a free download covering pricing, preparation, marketing, offers, negotiation and closing

The Houston Probate Home Sale Guide, a free PDF for executors and heirs in Harris, Fort Bend and Montgomery Counties, in English or Spanish: use the contact form and type "Probate Guide" in the message, and it is usually emailed the same day

facts.heading: Home search
facts.text: Search every active Houston MLS listing through HAR.com, updated daily, and save a search to get an alert when a matching home hits the market. Found one you love? Cesar can schedule a showing the same day.
